description: Frozen successor-state cases per BRIEF-FUSE-1 §W2, derived from B1-B7 defect mechanisms and interpretation rulings

SUC-01.description: V2 announced split → fund HALT with pending state; next session no adjustment yet → still HALT with pending carried; exact reconciliation supplied → auto-clear
SUC-01.mechanism: B1 - V2 pending and latched continuity

steps.description: Next session, adjustment not yet complete

SUC-02.description: V2 mismatch → latched HALT; later evaluation with reconciled ledger but NO authorized re-arm → still latched; re-arm event → clears

steps.description: Next session, ledger now reconciled but no re-arm event yet

SUC-03.description: O5 one rejection in session 1, one in session 2, one in session 3 → HALT never trips; rejection count resets at each session change

steps.description: Session 3, one rejection (count resets again, never reaches 3)

SUC-04.description: O5 three rejections within one session across three evaluations → HALT latches at the third; fourth evaluation in same session → still HALT
SUC-04.mechanism: B2 - O5 third rejection within session

steps.description: Third rejection, same session → latches HALT
Fourth evaluation, same session → still HALT

SUC-05.description: O1 source enumeration — one step per required source record class, exactly that record missing → O1 contributes NO-NEW-RISK; final step, all records present and fresh → O1 contributes NORMAL

steps.description: All sources present and fresh → clears

SUC-06.description: V4 at/above 2x → NO-NEW-RISK (fund), counter 0; then ten sessions below the level, with TWO evaluations inside session 3 — counter increments once for that session; counter = 9 after session 9 and clearing exactly at session 10
SUC-06.derivation_convention: Counter increments once per session below threshold, persists across restarts per §4.4 rule 3

steps.description: Session 2, below threshold, counter starts at 1
Session 3, second evaluation SAME SESSION — counter stays at 2
Seven further sessions below the level advance the counter from 2 to 9
steps.note: Counts 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9 occur on January 8, 9, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16 of 2026 respectively.

steps.description: Tenth session below the level (2026-01-20) clears the interlock

SUC-07.description: V4 counter at 4 → serialize next_row_state → restore (restart) → counter still 4; continue below-level sessions → clears at 10 total

steps.description: Continue to session 10 total below threshold → clears
steps.note: Counts 6, 7, 8, 9, 10 occur on January 13, 14, 15, 16, 20 of 2026 respectively. Count 10 clears the interlock.

SUC-08.description: V5 with v5_tolerance supplied and measured decay excess beyond tolerance for 70 consecutive sessions; diagnostic-only for sessions 1-39; at session 40 escalation to V1 treatment (NO-NEW-RISK in that fund); sessions 41-70 remain escalated
SUC-08.derivation_convention: Per brief instruction: persistence counter counts consecutive beyond-tolerance sessions; 'persists for two months' = 40 sessions

steps.note: Sessions 2 through 39 each increment counter by 1
Sessions 41-70 all show escalated_to_v1 = true and state = NO-NEW-RISK

SUC-09.description: O4 order A times out → ORDER-UNKNOWN (symbol A); terminal report for different order B → A unchanged; unrecognized status string for A → A unchanged; definitive terminal status for A → clears

steps.description: Order A for TQQQ times out
Terminal report for different order B on TQQQ → A unchanged
Unrecognized status string for order A → A unchanged
Definitive terminal status for order A → clears

SUC-10.description: O4 ORDER-UNKNOWN survives serialize/restore restart round-trip unchanged

SUC-11.description: Reserved for Phase 3 stub-swap deep-shape fixture — deep recursive shape comparison of full row outputs including V4/V5/V6 nested fields; negative control with injected nested mismatch must be detected
expected_deep_shape_checks: V4 per-fund counter, activity, threshold fields
V5 diagnostic object with 8 keys: excess_shortfall, consecutive_sessions, escalated_to_v1, disposition, etc.
V6 diagnostic object with 5 keys: cost_per_unit_exposure, threshold, exceeded, notify, etc.
Negative control: injected mismatch in nested V5.outputs.consecutive_sessions_beyond_tolerance type must fail deep comparison

SUC-12.description: L2 trips at drawdown >= 2D/3 → latched NO-NEW-RISK; drawdown recedes, then deposit, then tier_change evaluations → still latched; authorized re-arm event → clears
SUC-12.mechanism: Ruling L2 exact threshold + §4.4 rule 3 persistence across deposit/tier_change

steps.description: Drawdown recedes below threshold → still latched

SUC-13.description: V1 tracking deviation beyond 0.75pp → NO-NEW-RISK (fund), latched (breaker); deviation recedes next session → still latched until re-arm event clears it

steps.description: Next session, deviation recedes below threshold → still latched
